title: StrictLocalCohomologyGerms
statement: For L in D⁺(Ab(S_et)) and n an integer, define the derived sections presheaf U↦Hom(Z[U][0],L[n]). Define its canonical cohomology germ map by applying degree-zero homology, evaluation at the free generator and the homology shift isomorphism. Restrict this functor to the small affine pointed neighbourhoods of a geometric point s [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Define the source legs as the presheaf germs followed by the stalk map of this canonical comparison and the unique strict-local germ restriction transported through exact-inverse-image homology. The latter restriction is an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-germ-restriction-iso].

proof.text: Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
